items: UPS: no guarantee for ground-stop shipments. UPS said the FAA has restored flight operations after a nationwide U.S. ground stop and that it is resuming flights, though some shipments may be delayed. The UPS Service Guarantee and Money-Back Guarantee do not apply to shipments affected by the stop.

UPS posts revised Surge Emergency Fees notice. UPS's Rate and Service Guides page lists revised Surge Emergency Fees for selected services and lanes from Nov. 12, 2026, without amounts or lanes. The page also no longer shows the earlier notice of a per-package Ground and Ground Saver surcharge on certain origin ZIP codes from Dec. 21, 2026.

Miami-Dade to vote on delivery robots. The County Commission is set to vote Nov. 17 on ordinance 261932 covering sidewalk delivery robots. It would require permits and at least $100,000 in liability insurance, set speed limits, and allow fines of up to $500.
